retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, urban-influenced country music aesthetic featuring a seated male subject against a distressed white brick wall covered in layered, hand-painted charcoal typography.
triggerTerms: distressed wall with charcoal graffiti text
masculine portrait with layered street art background

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, textured composition where a male subject in dark clothing sits on a stool, integrated into a background of weathered white brick. The wall acts as a canvas for various styles of hand-drawn and stenciled typography in charcoal and grey tones, creating a 'scrawled' or 'journal entry' effect that surrounds the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in dark values contrasting against a light, textured background
Layered typography creating depth behind and around the subject
Rough, tactile textures of brick and paint strokes mirroring the subject's rugged styling
Diagonal lines in the subject's pose leading the eye toward the primary title text
coreInvariants: Distressed white brick or concrete wall background
Desaturated or monochromatic color palette with high contrast
Layered text with varying opacity and scale

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated in the lower right quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary title text in the upper left quadrant serves as the main visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold title, follows the vertical text on the left, moves across the subject's face, and settles on the secondary artist name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is filled with low-opacity 'ghost' text and wall texture to maintain a busy, lived-in feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and light grey (background wall and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal (subject clothing and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; the image relies on texture rather than hue.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochromatic or sepia-toned neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Varies between heavy brush scripts and condensed sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, dry-brush strokes with visible bristle textures
Secondary text mimics chalk or charcoal scrawls with varying pressure
Metadata text uses a clean, stenciled sans-serif for legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title feature elongated terminals and aggressive slants
Vertical text on the left is rotated 90 degrees with irregular baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured brush lettering paired with clean, authoritative stenciled sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: To match the raw, hand-painted energy of the main title.
To provide a structured contrast for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black denim shirt sitting on a stool against a weathered, white-painted brick wall. The lighting should be dramatic with high contrast. Leave the wall area mostly clear but with heavy texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted charcoal lettering in various styles (brush, scrawl, stencil) across the wall. Layer the text with different opacities to create depth, ensuring the primary title is the boldest element in the upper left.

verificationChecks: Is the text integrated into the wall texture rather than floating?
Does the brushwork show realistic bristle textures?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated?
Is the hierarchy between the title and artist name clear?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the brick wall
Intensity of the dry-brush texture in the font
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between paint and brick texture
Ensure no 'hallucinated' text characters in the background scrawl
Verify the subject's integration into the environment (shadows/lighting)
Confirm the vertical text on the left is legible but secondary
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated masculine portrait + distressed white brick wall + layered charcoal brush-lettering + monochromatic high-contrast lighting.
